agent_types.ObserverAgent: Collects data and monitors the environment to provide updated information for other agents in the system.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Analyzes data and makes decisions based on predefined rules or learned strategies to guide system actions.
agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Facilitates communication and cooperation among agents to ensure synchronized actions and efficient task execution.
agent_types.ResourceAgent: Manages and allocates resources within the system to optimize performance and achieve system goals.
agent_types.MaintenanceAgent: Monitors system health and performs necessary updates or repairs to maintain optimal functionality.
